title: Computed Profile
prompt:
Implement `void program(void)` that prints exactly:

```
grade=D (68)
int bytes=4
```

Line 1: compute the character `'D'` from `'A' + 3` (print it with %c) and its numeric code with %d. Line 2: compute the byte count with `sizeof(int)` and `%zu`. Do not hard-code `D`, `68`, or `4`.

tests.name: computed profile
tests.hint: char g = 'A' + 3; printf("grade=%c (%d)\n", g, g); then printf("int bytes=%zu\n", sizeof(int));
